summary: Frontend regression check after the refactor and the move to cookie sign-in, at desktop 1920 plus a quick mobile 390 pass of the worker dashboard. Everything requested passed: cookie login, reload, refresh and logout for admin and worker; role guards both ways; Admin Tasks (filter tabs and full create/edit/complete/delete with every form field); Admin Goals and Trips (assign to Love Tester, edit, progress, celebrate dialog, delete, Trips owner filter); Admin Essentials (create/edit/mark purchased/delete, owner filter); the worker dashboard (clock in/out with the timer ticking, deadlines, Start, Complete and reopen on a test task, GoalsCard create/edit/delete); worker Trips and Essentials; and every other admin and worker page. No page errors, error screens or blank screens. The only console errors were the expected 401s from /api/auth/me before login. Dialogs close on Escape and on an outside click, and reopening edit for a different task, goal or trip shows that item's data. Nothing was saved to localStorage; access_token and refresh_token are httpOnly, Secure cookies. All test data was removed afterwards.

minor.issue: The admin seed resets an existing admin's password whenever it differs from ADMIN_PASSWORD. The auth playbook says the seed must never change an existing admin's password. ADMIN_PASSWORD also falls back to the hardcoded default 'admin123' (line 4248). This was here before the refactor.

ui_bugs.issue: When a worker adds an essential, the 'For (optional)' field defaults to the first peer (workers[0] from /peers, currently Ms Ross) instead of 'Keep on my list'. A worker who doesn't change it puts the item on someone else's list. Admins also default to workers[0]. The old AdminEssentials.jsx did the same, so this is not a regression. Suggested fix: emptyEssential('') for workers.
On the Trips pages the button still says 'Edit goal'; it should come from the copy (e.g. 'Edit trip'). This was there before the refactor.

issues: The top-right Sonner toast briefly covers the main page button ('Assign trip to worker' / 'Add essential') at 1920 width.

action_items: EssentialForm: default 'For' to 'Keep on my list' (empty assignee) instead of workers[0], at least for workers.
WishlistCard: take the edit button label from the copy so Trips shows 'Edit trip'.
GoalsCard.jsx:130/171 still reads localStorage 'access_token' directly to build image URLs; switch to fileUrl() from lib/api for consistency (the website works through cookies, so nothing is broken).
Optional, backend: make the admin seed create-only so it never resets an existing admin's password, and drop the 'admin123' fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: lib/api.js:27 sets withCredentials false, so cookies only travel because the site and API share an origin. A cross-origin web host would fall back to a Bearer token. This is documented in the code comment and is fine for this preview and deployment.

GoalsCard.jsx (323 lines) was not refactored: it keeps its own dialog state, file handling and status logic, duplicating wishlist/GoalFields, GoalProgress and lib/wishlist statusOf. It is a good candidate for reusing useDialogState and GoalFields.
useOutsideClose depends on onClose; callers must memoise it, or the listener is re-attached on every render (harmless, but churny).

Inline price editing on the admin task row is not in the current or the pre-refactor code (it was removed much earlier). Price is changed through the Edit dialog, which was verified (7.25 -> 9.50). Not a regression.

success_rate.backend: n/a (frontend-only request; playbook auth checks passed except seed_admin)

seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted (by id): tasks TEST_RefactorTask (6496b4bf...) and TEST_WorkerFlowTask (2f463efc...); goal TEST_Refactor_goal; trips TEST_Refactor_trip and TEST_WorkerTrip; essential TEST_RefactorEssential; worker goal TEST_WorkerGoal. Afterwards no TEST_ tasks, goals, trips or essentials of mine remain. Side effects that remain: one clock-in/out time entry of about 5 seconds for Love Tester (no delete UI), and a login_attempts lockout record for the made-up email TEST_bruteforce_x@loveworks.com from the brute-force check. Ms Ross's data was not touched. Leftover data from earlier runs is still there and was not deleted: UI_Test_Goal_1780818431 (owned by Ms Ross), TEST_AdminOwnGoal and 'Demo: Bluetooth speaker' (owned by the admin).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie auth checks: login gives httpOnly, Secure access_token and refresh_token cookies; after deleting the access_token cookie and reloading, the session renews through /auth/refresh. Brute-force lockout returns 429 on the 6th attempt. CORS does not send allow-origin for an unknown origin.
